SELECT p.id,t.id AS task_id,p.user_id,p.period,p.plan_mode,p.plan_date,p.end_date, p.history_reason,p.arranged_by_id,p.source,p.arranged_at,p.creator,p.create_time, p.updater,p.update_time,p.deleted, c.depth>0 AS inherited, CASE WHEN c.depth>0 THEN p.task_id ELSE NULL END AS inherited_from_task_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.user_id,p.plan_mode,p.period,p.plan_date, CASE WHEN p.plan_mode='SCHEDULE' THEN p.id ELSE '' END ORDER BY c.depth,p.arranged_at DESC,p.id) AS preference FROM checklist_ancestors c JOIN public.nocode_task_plan p ON p.task_id=c.id WHERE p.user_id=#{user} AND p.deleted=0 AND ((p.plan_mode='SCHEDULE' AND c.depth=0) OR ()) ) effective WHERE t.deleted=0 AND t.id IN #{id} AND effective.preference=1 ORDER BY t.id,effective.plan_date,effective.period,effective.id
